camel_example: aliyun arms CreateEnvironment --region cn-hangzhou --EnvironmentSubType 'ECS、ACK等。' --EnvironmentType CS --EnvironmentName env1 --BindResourceId c6e9dec475dca4a50a188411d8cbxxx --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
kebab_example: aliyun arms create-environment --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --environment-name env1 --environment-type CS --environment-sub-type 'ECS、ACK等。' --bind-resource-id c6e9dec475dca4a50a188411d8cbxxx --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEnvironment

parameters.help_zh: 语言环境, 默认为中文
parameters.name: aliyun_lang

parameters.help_en:
The type of the environment. Valid values:
CS: Container Service.
ECS: ECS.
Cloud: Cloud service
parameters.help_zh:
环境类型：
CS：容器服务。
ECS：ECS。
Cloud：云服务
parameters.name: environment_type

parameters.help_en:
The subtype of the environment:
CS environments: ACK and One are supported.
ECS environments: ECS is supported.
Cloud environments: Cloud is supported
parameters.help_zh:
环境的子类型：
CS类型的环境：目前支持ACK、One子类型。
ECS类型的环境：目前支持ECS子类型。
Cloud类型的环境：目前支持Cloud子类型
parameters.name: environment_sub_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource instance bound to the environment, such as a container instance ID or a VPC ID. For Cloud environments, set this parameter to the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
环境绑定的资源实例ID，包括容器实例ID或VpcId。
对于Cloud类型的环境，当前字段值为RegionId
parameters.name: bind_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The managed type. Valid values:
none: Unmanaged. This is the default value for ACK clusters.
agent: Managed agent, including ksm. This is the default value for ASK, ACS, and AckOne clusters.
agent-exporter: Managed agent and exporter. This is the default value for cloud service environments
parameters.help_zh:
托管类型：
none： 非托管。ACK集群的默认值。
agent：托管agent（含ksm）。ASK、ACS、AckOne集群的默认值。
agent-exporter： 托管agent和exporter。云服务类型的默认值
parameters.name: managed_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing plan.
If EnvironmentType is set to CS, you can set this parameter to CS_Basic (default) or CS_Pro.
If EnvironmentType is set to other values, leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
付费套餐。
EnvironmentType为CS时：可以指定为CS_Basic（默认值）或CS_Pro。
EnvironmentType为其它值时，请输入空值
parameters.name: fee_package

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Prometheus instance bound to the environment. This parameter can be left empty. If it is not provided, call the InitEnvironment operation to initialize the storage instance
parameters.help_zh: 可空，环境绑定的prom实例id。如果未提供，请调用 InitEnvironment 接口完成存储实例的初始化
parameters.name: prometheus_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Grafana workspace bound to the environment. If this parameter is left empty, the default shared Grafana workspace is used
parameters.help_zh: 环境绑定的grafana工作区id。传空时，表示使用默认的共享grafana
parameters.name: grafana_workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The tags that you want to add to the instance for management
parameters.help_zh: 可以传此参数，给实例创建标签进行管理
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to initialize the environment
parameters.name: init_environment

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. A status code of 200 indicates success

Data.description_en: The ID of the created environment

Message.description_en: The message returned in the response
